Reserve automatic public Search synthesis through the canonical ledger using the full evidence and planned answer budget, preserving the signed cap for private research.
Preserve a document's requested format when the format is specified after the creation brief, and keep its tables editable in Word.
Recognize explicit local file formats on named document subtypes and keep file delivery instructions out of the authored document.
Remove directions to unavailable calculator inputs while retaining the worked calculation and unrelated content.
Keep calculator sensitivity and boundary examples distinct from the active result being checked.
Keep a sensitivity chart's computed series separate from the calculator's selected value while still checking explicit labeled scalar rows.
Apply a verified local factual correction in place when it resolves the only flagged issue in an ordinary plain answer.
Reuse an unchanged native answer tree during unrelated Workspace updates.
Keep native boxes within the reading column and let their contents determine height.
Respect explicit prose-only or excluded presentation formats in final response assembly.

Keep provider diagnostics and retry details out of public failure messages.

auth.description: Use the existing authenticated Workspace and Search paths.

cost.description: Automatic public Search synthesis uses a conservative reservation under the existing account entitlement. The separate signed private research cap, paid retrieval bounds, provider accounting, and one-dispatch rule remain enforced.

billing.description: Preserve actual provider receipts, canonical settlement and limit enforcement.

tests.scope: Preserve independent content and withhold conflicting prose, branches, tables and prerequisite order.

Verify direct and deferred download requests, encoded Office artifacts, and negative cases for app features, conflicting formats and declined downloads.
Verify signed-in rendered responses, Copy, Share revocation and Reopen, including obsolete and reviewable research records on isolated accounts.
Verify oversized boxes reflow, short model dimensions keep prose visible, and SVG geometry remains intact across viewport widths.

architecture.reason: Use the existing chat pipeline, presentation validator and public research broker.

blockers: Fresh DeepSeek acceptance, isolated Search storage verification and an exact Ready production frontend artifact remain required.
